messages.subject: Meeting Wednesday 10-12
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies!

We are back at it again tomorrow for our typical meeting time, 10-noon in the Datalab classroom (360 Shields library). It is a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and sit in with us as you work. This is a hybrid meeting so you can also join us via Zoom at this link: https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09 

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators 

--
